\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 188-191 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R196-first-pass-words-from-chapters-188-191}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for pickle and chutney.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a university, a college, a police station, a flat, a storey
  \item a court of law, a prison, a cave, a ravine, a waterfall
  \item rather, perhaps, certainly, unfortunately, a result
  \item necessary, possible, modern, ancient, real
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A university? (\textbf{\bn{বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়}}, \emph{bishvôbidyālôy}.) A college? (\textbf{\bn{কলেজ}}, \emph{kôlej}.) A police station? (\textbf{\bn{থানা}}, \emph{thānā}.) A flat? (\textbf{\bn{ফ্ল্যাট}}, \emph{phlæṭ}.) A storey? (\textbf{\bn{তলা}}, \emph{tôlā}.) A court of law? (\textbf{\bn{আদালত}}, \emph{ādālôt}.) A prison? (\textbf{\bn{জেল}}, \emph{jel}.) A cave? (\textbf{\bn{গুহা}}, \emph{guhā}.) A ravine? (\textbf{\bn{খাদ}}, \emph{khād}.) A waterfall? (\textbf{\bn{ঝরনা}}, \emph{jhôrnā}.) Rather? (\textbf{\bn{বরং}}, \emph{bôrông}.) Perhaps? (\textbf{\bn{হয়তো}}, \emph{hôyto}.) Certainly? (\textbf{\bn{নিশ্চয়ই}}, \emph{nishchôyi}.) Unfortunately? (\textbf{\bn{দুর্ভাগ্যবশত}}, \emph{durbhāgyôbôshôtô}.) A result? (\textbf{\bn{ফলাফল}}, \emph{phôlāphôl}.) Necessary? (\textbf{\bn{দরকারি}}, \emph{dôrkāri}.) Possible? (\textbf{\bn{সম্ভব}}, \emph{sômbhôb}.) Modern? (\textbf{\bn{আধুনিক}}, \emph{ādhunik}.) Ancient? (\textbf{\bn{প্রাচীন}}, \emph{prāchīn}.) Real? (\textbf{\bn{আসল}}, \emph{āsôl}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Disappointed? (\textbf{\bn{হতাশ}}, \emph{hôtāsh}.) Simple? (\textbf{\bn{সরল}}, \emph{sôrôl}.) Complicated? (\textbf{\bn{জটিল}}, \emph{jôṭil}.) Separate? (\textbf{\bn{আলাদা}}, \emph{ālādā}.) The same? (\textbf{\bn{একই}}, \emph{eki}.) Huge? (\textbf{\bn{বিশাল}}, \emph{bishāl}.) Medium? (\textbf{\bn{মাঝারি}}, \emph{mājhāri}.) Nearby? (\textbf{\bn{কাছের}}, \emph{kāchher}.) Personal? (\textbf{\bn{ব্যক্তিগত}}, \emph{bæktigôtô}.) Public? (\textbf{\bn{সরকারি}}, \emph{sôrkāri}.) A brush? (\textbf{\bn{ব্রাশ}}, \emph{brāsh}.) An iron? (\textbf{\bn{ইস্ত্রি}}, \emph{istri}.) A jug? (\textbf{\bn{জগ}}, \emph{jôg}.) A kettle? (\textbf{\bn{কেটলি}}, \emph{keṭli}.) A basket? (\textbf{\bn{ঝুড়ি}}, \emph{jhuṛi}.) A jacket? (\textbf{\bn{জ্যাকেট}}, \emph{jækeṭ}.) A raincoat? (\textbf{\bn{রেনকোট}}, \emph{renkoṭ}.) A belt? (\textbf{\bn{বেল্ট}}, \emph{belṭ}.) A button? (\textbf{\bn{বোতাম}}, \emph{botām}.) An earring? (\textbf{\bn{দুল}}, \emph{dul}.) Biryani? (\textbf{\bn{বিরিয়ানি}}, \emph{biriyāni}.) Khichuri? (\textbf{\bn{খিচুড়ি}}, \emph{khichuṛi}.) A croquette? (\textbf{\bn{চপ}}, \emph{chôp}.) Pickle? (\textbf{\bn{আচার}}, \emph{āchār}.) Chutney? (\textbf{\bn{চাটনি}}, \emph{chāṭni}.)
